import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter

im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
# Unsharp-mask style local contrast: subtract heavy blur, add back
blur = im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(25))
a = np.array(im).astype(np.float32)
b = np.array(blur).astype(np.float32)
detail = a - b
out = np.clip(b*0.8 + detail*2.2 + 30, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
res = Image.fromarray(out)
res.save('crops/localcontrast.png')
w,h = res.size
q = {'lc_ul':(0,0,w//2,h//2),'lc_ur':(w//2,0,w,h//2),'lc_ll':(0,h//2,w//2,h),'lc_lr':(w//2,h//2,w,h)}
for name,(x1,y1,x2,y2) in q.items():
    c = res.crop((x1,y1,x2,y2)).resize((w//2, h//2), Image.LANCZOS)
    c.save(f'crops/{name}.png')
print('ok')
